*Nicco's fist drives into Maren's midsection with full weight behind it. The impact folds Maren forward with a sharp, involuntary expulsion of breath — knees buckling, one hand clutching his stomach as he staggers back a half-step, eyes wide and watering. He drops to one knee on the living floor, still gripping his middle, unable to draw a full breath for several seconds.*

*Maren's mouth opens but nothing comes out except a thin, strangled sound. He stays down, curled slightly inward, blinking hard.*
